description.value: American Airlines LAS → JFK is the outbound American Airlines row from Las Vegas into New York JFK. American flies into three major airports in the New York City area, and JFK is one of the airline's hubs. Its JFK terminal has an Admirals Club lounge, and American advises arriving at least 2 hours before domestic flights at LAS. Exact departure times are not fixed in this row, so pick the schedule in American's booking tool.
